title: port/test/framegate.py: every checkpoint of a pinned scenario with gfx + LiveTerrain, by region
gate: framegate.py runs a scenario's checkpoints in one boot with gfx.attach and LiveTerrain attached (a Terrain object address for scenarios without a pin recording, shown not to change any sim hash), writes one TSV row per checkpoint (scenario, checkpoint, status PASS / FAIL <px by region> / UNSUPPORTED <first unsupported call> / NOT_RUN <boot status>, terrain on screen yes / no with the rule that decides it, per region: px differing, one-level px and %, px beyond one level, plus the distinct unsupported calls before the snapshot); regions per screen kind derived from the frame code (title menu = gfx.menu_regions, location screen, in-game view vs toolbar / status / ticker panels, else whole frame); on the HEAD export sandbox_basic menu and cov_b_location's 5 checkpoints read PASS exactly as test_gfx does, a course_season in-game checkpoint gives a terrain-on-screen yes row; controls RED: gfx negctl 1 on menu reads FAIL, a swapped reference reads FAIL, and the boot's per-frame sim hashes with both attached equal the boot gate's; resumable per scenario, --jobs N, at most 2 processes
notes: develop in the shared tree path (owned files) but run on the HEAD export port/build/S0_head with the owned files copied in, build dir port/build/S0_head/port/build/S0_2; only single-scenario runs (light); the full census is S0.3; ACCEPTED 2026-10-24: test_framegate 32 passed (2_test_framegate.log), controls 2/2 RED (2_ctl_negctl1.tsv, 2_ctl_swap.tsv), 1 blind (region rectangles); merge recommendations 2_merge.md; U-1110..U-1115
